name: Obama
text: Obama (小浜市, Obama-shi; Japanese pronunciation: [ò̞.bä́.mä́(.ɕì)]; lit. 'Small Beach') is a city located in Fukui Prefecture, Japan. As of 1 August 2018, the city had an estimated population of 29,435 in 12,057 households and a population density of 240 persons per km2 (327/sq mi).
